subheader: Collaborate with us to create sustainable impact and strengthen communities across Nigeria.
description: We welcome partnerships with businesses, foundations, government institutions, faith-based organizations, and development agencies. Together, we can expand our reach and deepen our impact.
whyDescription: Partnerships are essential to our mission. By working together, we can achieve more for vulnerable communities.
sharedImpactDescription: Your support directly contributes to measurable improvements in the lives of children, families, and communities.
csrAlignmentDescription: Demonstrate meaningful social responsibility through transparent, community-driven partnerships.
visibilityDescription: Partners are recognized across our platforms, reports, and events in accordance with partnership agreements.
networkAccessDescription: Connect with other mission-aligned organizations and stakeholders across Nigeria.
typeFinancialDescription: Provide grants, institutional funding, or corporate donations to support program delivery and operational growth.
typeTechnicalDescription: Offer expertise, training, capacity building, or advisory support to strengthen our programs.
typeInKindDescription: Donate goods, equipment, facilities, or professional services that directly benefit communities.
typeImplementingDescription: Collaborate on joint programs, shared resources, or co-designed initiatives in specific regions.
message: Tell us about your organization and potential partnership goals
messagePlaceholder: Brief description of your organization, mission alignment, and how you'd like to collaborate
thankYouMessage: A member of our partnerships team will respond within 5-7 business days to explore next steps.
currentPartnersDescription: We are grateful to work alongside the following organizations and institutions.
strategicPartnerDescription: For major institutional partnerships, multi-year commitments, or large-scale grant funding, please contact our executive team directly.
